groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: Hand on the left: doing something to a thing.

chars.story: A hand sets things down in a row and stops: arranged.
A hand pokes at something that wanted to be left alone: disturb.
A hand lifts the lid and shows what is inside: expose.
A hand pulls one thing out from among the others: pull out.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 臿 pestle in a mortar
chars.story: A hand drives a pestle into the mortar: insert.

chars.parts: 扌 hand + 昜 rising sun (sound)
chars.story: A hand tosses something up toward the rising sun: hoist.
A hand sketches out how it will be done: draft.
chars.note: 拟 stands for 擬: the right side was simplified to 以.

groups.title: person 亻
groups.note: A person standing at the left.

chars.story: A person keeping to one side of the line: lateral.
A person standing slanted off to one side: slant, biased.
A figure of a person set beside another by chance: a pair, accidental.
A person sets goods aside for later: store.
The common ways of the people of the valley: custom.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: water, liquid, rising.

chars.story: Following the water's edge: along.
Water that gathers overnight: liquid.
Water stretching up its banks: rise in price.
chars.note: 涨 stands for 漲. Also water 'rising': 涨水.

chars.story: Water cuts through the same spot again and again until there is a hole.

groups.title: animals
groups.note: Creatures you will see in everyday prose.

chars.parts: - a bird with an eye-dot, body and legs
chars.story: A small bird with an eye-dot, a body and legs below.
The animal that creeps through the sprouts after mice: a cat.
The animal that roots about the farmhouse: a pig.

groups.title: animal 犭
groups.note: The animal sign on the left, used for acts as well as beasts.

chars.story: An animal that stops, unsure which way to go: hesitate.
chars.note: 犹 stands for 猶. Also 'still, just like': 犹如 'just like'.

chars.story: A wary animal sniffing round the edges to work it out: guess.
Sitting astride a horse: ride.
Add the horse to the cart and drive it.

chars.parts: - a person standing on a tree-frame, climbing up
chars.story: A person climbs up onto the frame to ride along.
A hand joins one thing onto another: connect, catch a ride.
A heart gone cold and stiff as a sheet: terror.
The heart of a slave, seething: anger.
A heart that keeps turning toward others: kindness.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'favour'. Same shape. Today mostly 优惠 'discount'.

chars.story: Heart rising out of the ashes: restore.
Worries strung together in the heart: trouble.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'trouble'. Now mostly illness.

chars.story: A sickness that strikes like an arrow: an ailment.
A stone lying in the road: it obstructs you.

chars.parts: - a slash cutting across the step
chars.story: Your steps cut short before you arrive: short of.
A person falls into a pit in the hill and gets stuck.
Shells delivered as the fruit of work: tribute.
Shell-money handed down as a prize: reward.
Shell-money listed in long columns: accounts.
A person blamed for what they owe: debt.
A paper cut in two with a knife, each side keeping half: a voucher.
Words rising around a name: its reputation.
A grass mat laid out to put someone forward: recommend.
A tall tree standing firm in the fire: an outstanding person.
Work with a neat little twist at the end: skillful.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'clever'. Same shape. Also 'by coincidence': 碰巧.

chars.story: The small child of your child: a grandson.
chars.note: 孙 stands for 孫. Also a surname.

chars.parts: 幺 tiny thread + 力 strength
chars.story: Thin thread and little strength: young.
Count the teeth to know how old: age.
An older woman of the family: an aunt.
A woman dancing to please a crowd: amusement.

groups.title: mound and town 阝
groups.note: Left it is a mound, right it is a town.

chars.story: A mound standing between two places: separate.
From town to town: the post.
The town beside yours: a neighbor.
chars.note: 鄰 became 邻: the 阝 stays, the rest was simplified. His Analects card: 'neighbour'.

chars.story: A boundary drawn all the way around: round.

chars.parts: - grain stalks standing level in a row
chars.story: Stalks of grain all standing level: even.
chars.note: 齊 became 齐. His Analects card: 'equal'.

chars.story: Clear as ice, nothing left to fight over: clean.
Many threads quickly tangled: complicated.
A thread tying two people together: a fated bond.
chars.note: 缘 stands for 緣. Also 'edge, hem'.

chars.story: The loose end of a thread: where the clue starts.
Silk drawn out gently: gradual.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 人 person + 木 tree
chars.story: Leaves picked from a bush while a person sits under the tree: tea.

chars.parts: 饣 food + 欠 gaping mouth
chars.story: A mouth wide open over the food: drink.
chars.note: 饮 stands for 飲. More formal than 喝: 饮料 'beverage', 饮食 'diet'.

chars.story: A smooth round fruit of a green plant: an apple.
chars.note: Appears only in 苹果 'apple'. 苹 stands for 蘋.

chars.story: A great leaf standing on the pond: a lotus leaf.

groups.title: walk 辶 and run 走

chars.story: A walker speeding along: rapid.
Measuring every step as you go: late.
Walking off a thousand miles to settle elsewhere: relocate.
Running toward the hay: heading that way.

groups.title: foot 足
groups.note: The foot sign on the left.

chars.story: A foot stepping wide across a gap: stride.
The marks a foot leaves behind: a footprint.

groups.title: flesh 月
groups.note: Moon-shape on the left is flesh.

chars.story: Flesh wrapped around the baby: the womb.
The side of the body just under the arm: the flank, pressed on to threaten.
chars.note: 胁 stands for 脅. Reads as 'threaten' in prose.

chars.parts: 广 lean-to + 付 hand over + 肉 meat
chars.story: Meat left under a shed: rotten.
A boat that watches the seas: a warship.
A wooden tool with an edge to be wary of: an appliance, apparatus.
Fire wrapped up inside a barrel: a cannon.
Metal as tough as a rock ridge: steel.
Marching in step under a weapon: service.

chars.parts: - a hand gripping something by the tail
chars.story: A hand holds something by the tail: it belongs to you.

chars.parts: - a single-edged blade with a handle
chars.story: A single-edged blade with a handle.

chars.parts: - a nail seen from the side
chars.story: A nail seen from the side: a grown man in older use.
chars.note: Also a surname and the fourth of the ten Heavenly Stems.

chars.story: The sun just above the horizon line: dawn.

chars.parts: 王 jade + 廾 two hands
chars.story: Two hands turning a piece of jade over: playing with it.
chars.note: Often just 'do, make': 弄脏 'get dirty'.

chars.story: Jade with a streak like a horse's mane: agate.
chars.note: Mostly a sound in foreign names, like 玛丽 Mary. 玛 stands for 瑪.

chars.story: A mouth speaking up to a ruler: presenting.

chars.parts: 口 mouth + 口 mouth + 犬 dog
chars.story: Two mouths and a dog, all howling: crying.
A big mouth blowing out big claims: exaggerate.
chars.note: Above all the Tang dynasty and a surname.

chars.story: Bones laid into the earth to feed new growth: reproduction.
Red against bare bone stands out: it differs.
Words that tell it fully, one sheep counted at a time: detailed.
Words from many persons: various.

chars.parts: - a tall headdress set on the head
chars.story: A tall headdress set on the head: put on.
chars.note: Used for hats, glasses, jewelry, gloves.

chars.story: A cloth draped over the table for a feast: decorate.
The face and its hue: color.
The tip of a mountain: a peak.
Earth walls that protect: a fortress.
chars.note: In 汉堡 it is a loan sound.

chars.story: A shed built on the earth: a farmstead.
Ears open for idle talk: chat.

chars.parts: 行 walk + 角 horn + 大 big
chars.story: A balance beam hung between horn and weights: weigh.
A head pushed out from under a hat: it bursts out, emerges.
A slash and 'go': the thing slips away, and you lose it.
After the knife has cut its share, what is left: left over.

sentences.en: He is suffering from a bad cold in the nose.
The missing cat has not been found yet.
So as to avoid being late, we went by car.
I came across my aunt in Europe.
He liberated the people from bondage.

sentences.zh: 爱丁堡的水边地工程可能会把诸如此类的事情改变。
sentences.en: The Edinburgh Waterfront project could be about to change all that.
